title: Homilies on Judges, Homilia I
blurb: Origen’s Homilia I on Judges (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–4.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia I on Judges — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; modern FOTC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia I §§1–4 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VII (GCS 30, 1921), Rufinus’s Latin of Homilia I. Modern FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Homilia I §§1–4 (closeout).
